documents.title: Tooth-scale Stress Localisation in a µCT-derived Otodus megalodon Model
documents.description: Calibrated CT geometry, regional stress quantiles, targeted mesh refinement, material and attachment sensitivity, same-domain P1/P2 verification, paired interface/threshold checks, an independently verified full-objective 10 kPa neo-Hookean jaw control, conservative jaw-to-root transfer and unit-margin tensile responses, the native-domain module with synthetic verification, registered axial field comparisons, full native crown–root views, native curvature and CT-guided partition figures, the independently checked 100 mm MR5 control, and anisotropic/cohesive coupons. Includes public native, optimised and 200M exterior data links.
